title: Elephant eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- Body -->
    <ellipse cx='46' cy='64' rx='26' ry='20' fill='#8fa9c9'/>
    <!-- Belly shade -->
    <ellipse cx='46' cy='72' rx='18' ry='10' fill='#b3c7e0'/>
    <!-- Head -->
    <circle cx='72' cy='46' r='16' fill='#9fb6d4'/>
    <!-- Ear -->
    <ellipse cx='64' cy='44' rx='8' ry='9' fill='#7f9bc0'/>
    <ellipse cx='64' cy='44' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#c9d9ec'/>
    <!-- Eye -->
    <circle cx='76' cy='42' r='2.6' fill='#2c2a4a'/>
    <circle cx='77' cy='41' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <!-- Trunk curling up holding snack -->
    <path d='M84 52 Q92 56 90 66 Q88 76 80 78 Q74 79 71 74' fill='none' stroke='#9fb6d4' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- Snack: bread roll -->
    <ellipse cx='80' cy='78' rx='7' ry='5.5' fill='#e8b66a'/>
    <ellipse cx='80' cy='76' rx='5' ry='2.5' fill='#f6d49a'/>
    <!-- Legs -->
    <rect x='28' y='78' width='10' height='14' rx='4' fill='#7f9bc0'/>
    <rect x='44' y='80' width='10' height='13' rx='4' fill='#9fb6d4'/>
    <rect x='58' y='78' width='10' height='14' rx='4' fill='#7f9bc0'/>
    <!-- Tail -->
    <path d='M20 60 Q12 58 13 50' fill='none' stroke='#b3c7e0' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- Tusk -->
    <path d='M82 58 Q85 64 80 66' fill='none' stroke='#fdf7e3' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
</svg>
